title: System context
description: The investigator supplies a brief and evidence, then reviews hypotheses before applying a fix.

title: Component architecture
description: The FastAPI gateway coordinates retrieval, inference and persistence; React renders the workspace.

title: Investigation workflow
description: The nine stages of a complete investigation, including the draft path and evidence-gap feedback loop.

title: Evidence data flow
description: A source reference records a document, passage number and original excerpt. Weak matches become explicit gaps.

title: Analysis sequence
description: Two model passes or the offline classifier produce candidates. The gateway computes scores independently.

title: Entity relationships
description: The same logical entities are kept locally and in Supabase. Cloud keys include the authenticated owner.

title: Ishikawa mapping
description: Illustrative candidate branches, not confirmed causes. Each analyzed case has its own interactive fishbone.

title: 5-Why expansion
description: Each step is a testable hypothesis with its own related passage or evidence-gap flag.

title: Root cause ranking
description: The weighted sum ranks candidates, not the probability of a failure. A human verifies the proposed action.

title: Case lifecycle
description: Drafts can be analyzed, reviewed, resolved, and reopened without losing source evidence.

title: Deployment boundaries
description: The local application runs without cloud credentials. Model inference and cloud archival are separate opt-in paths.
